{{Quote|Count Dooku, we have picked up three life forms crossing the desert. One is a very young Huttlet.|The OOM command battle droid reports to Count Dooku|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
Following the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], this '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''' was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He reported on the approach of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who were returning the kidnapped [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] to his father, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]].
